answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 36542 Country: India Title: Islamic Names Question: My sister knew that she is having the male baby through ultrasound scan. In-sha-Allah she got her due date by next month. So we want the meaning of these names: Affan, Afnaan, Rihan, Maseen, Hanoon. Please tell the meaning of these names and suggest me which is the best choice among these? Answer ID: 36542 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 241/134/H=1433) Affan was the name of Hadhrat Usman Ghani's (رضى الله عنه) father. You can keep this name or keep Raihan which means fragrance. We do not know the meaning of Maseen and Hanoon, do not keep them. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
